Punjab Police Reshuffle: 12 IPS and 112 PPS Officers Transferred

The Punjab government has conducted a significant reshuffle within its police department, transferring 12 Indian Police Service (IPS) officers and 112 Provincial Police Service (PPS) officers. Among the notable postings, V Neeraja has been appointed as Special Director General (DGP) for NRI affairs. The transfers involve new postings for all affected officers, with a list of these new assignments being released.
